description: This file defines the LDAPConfigAPI class which handles CRUD operations for LDAP configuration in the OrangeHRM system, including updating and retrieving LDAP settings via API endpoints.

classes.name: LDAPConfigAPI
classes.description: API class for managing LDAP configuration settings including update and retrieval endpoints, utilizing traits for configuration and validation, and implementing resource endpoint interface.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating LDAP configuration based on API request data, including validation and setting of LDAP settings object.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves current LDAP configuration settings, returns default if none are set.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception as delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating LDAP configuration; excludes ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; delete operation not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving LDAP configuration (excludes ID parameter).

methods.name: setConfigAttributes
methods.description: Sets basic LDAP configuration attributes such as enable, host, port, encryption, implementation, bind details, and sync interval from API request.

methods.name: setDataMappingAttributes
methods.description: Sets LDAP data field mappings based on provided array.

methods.name: setUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Adds user lookup settings to LDAP configuration based on provided array of settings.
